SELECT
  TO_CHAR(i.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fecha,
  i.doctor_id,
  COALESCE(doc.name, 'Sin médico') AS doctor_name,
  COALESCE(pat.name, '')          AS patient_name,
  COALESCE(sc.name, 'Servicio')   AS service_name,
  i.doc_no                        AS invoice_doc_no,
  i.currency,
  -- Grupos a los que pertenece el SERVICIO facturado en esta línea (no el
  -- paciente): un tratamiento pertenece a un grupo (ej. "Brackets") cuando su
  -- servicio está vinculado a ese grupo vía group_services.
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', g.id, 'name', g.name) ORDER BY g.name), '[]'::json)
    FROM group_services gs JOIN groups g ON g.id = gs.group_id
    WHERE gs.service_id = ii.service_id
      AND ($5::uuid[] IS NULL OR gs.group_id = ANY($5::uuid[]))
  )                               AS patient_groups,
  ii.total                        AS importe
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN invoices i        ON i.id = ii.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN users pat    ON pat.id = i.user_id
LEFT JOIN users doc    ON doc.id = i.doctor_id
LEFT JOIN service_catalog sc ON sc.id = ii.service_id
WHERE i.is_sales = true
  AND i.type   = 'invoice'
  AND i.status = 'booked'
  AND i.created_at::date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
  AND ($3::varchar IS NULL OR i.currency = $3::varchar)
  AND ($4::uuid[] IS NULL OR i.doctor_id = ANY($4::uuid[]))
  AND ($5::uuid[] IS NULL OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM group_services gs WHERE gs.service_id = ii.service_id AND gs.group_id = ANY($5::uuid[])
  ))
  AND ($6::int[] IS NULL OR i.sede_id = ANY($6::int[]))
ORDER BY fecha ASC, doctor_name ASC, i.doc_no ASC

SELECT
  TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fecha,
  p.doctor_id,
  COALESCE(doc.name, 'Sin médico')       AS doctor_name,
  COALESCE(pat.name, '')                 AS patient_name,
  inv.doc_no                             AS invoice_doc_no,
  COALESCE(pm.name, p.method, 'N/D')     AS payment_method,
  p.currency,
  -- Grupos derivados de los servicios de las facturas que cubre el pago: la
  -- de p.invoice_id y/o las de payment_allocations (pagos a cuenta sin FK
  -- directa). Atribución completa: el pago pertenece a cada grupo tocado por
  -- alguno de esos servicios vía group_services.
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', gg.id, 'name', gg.name) ORDER BY gg.name), '[]'::json)
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT g.id, g.name
      FROM invoice_items ii2
      JOIN group_services gs ON gs.service_id = ii2.service_id
      JOIN groups g ON g.id = gs.group_id
      WHERE ii2.invoice_id IN (
              SELECT p.invoice_id WHERE p.invoice_id IS NOT NULL
              UNION
              SELECT pa.invoice_id FROM payment_allocations pa WHERE pa.payment_id = p.id
            )
        AND ($5::uuid[] IS NULL OR gs.group_id = ANY($5::uuid[]))
    ) gg
  )                                      AS patient_groups,
  p.amount                               AS importe
FROM payments p
LEFT JOIN users pat            ON pat.id = p.user_id
LEFT JOIN users doc            ON doc.id = p.doctor_id
LEFT JOIN invoices inv         ON inv.id = p.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN payment_methods pm   ON pm.id = p.payment_method_id
LEFT JOIN cash_sessions cs     ON cs.id = p.cash_session_id
LEFT JOIN cash_points cp       ON cp.id = cs.cash_point_id
WHERE p.is_sales = true
  AND p.created_at::date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
  AND ($3::varchar IS NULL OR p.currency = $3::varchar)
  AND ($4::uuid[] IS NULL OR p.doctor_id = ANY($4::uuid[]))
  AND ($5::uuid[] IS NULL OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM invoice_items ii3
    JOIN group_services gs2 ON gs2.service_id = ii3.service_id
    WHERE ii3.invoice_id IN (
              SELECT p.invoice_id WHERE p.invoice_id IS NOT NULL
              UNION
              SELECT pa.invoice_id FROM payment_allocations pa WHERE pa.payment_id = p.id
            )
      AND gs2.group_id = ANY($5::uuid[])
  ))
  -- La sede de un pago se determina por la caja (cash_point) donde se cobró,
  -- no por la sede de la factura — un pago de una caja de la Sede B pertenece
  -- a la Sede B aunque la factura se haya emitido desde otra sede.
  AND ($6::int[] IS NULL OR cp.sede_id = ANY($6::int[]))
ORDER BY fecha ASC, doctor_name ASC
